headline: Colombia Central Bank Reports Electronic Trading System Closing Data
summary: The Banco de la República reported closing statistics for the Electronic Trading System (SEN) as of November 18, 2026, detailing market behavior and traded instruments.
why: Transparency in central bank market data is vital for local financial institutions and investors to assess liquidity conditions and pricing trends in the Colombian fixed-income market.

impacts.name: COLCAP
impacts.why: Regular reporting of trading data helps maintain market efficiency and provides benchmarks for local asset pricing.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
